title: Towards trustworthy multi-modal motion prediction: Holistic evaluation and interpretability of outputs
reasoning: The paper explicitly states its aim to design 'trustworthy motion prediction systems' based on 'Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence,' which it defines as encompassing 'multiple ethical principles, requirements, and criteria to guarantee that AI systems are designed following a human-centered approach and committed to social good.' The work then focuses on evaluation criteria, robustness, and interpretability of outputs as components of this trustworthy AI design.
